title: Set up EntraPolicySuite's mail: a shared mailbox, sent from by the engine only
purpose: Creates (or uses) a shared mailbox and gives the engine's managed identity the right to send as that mailbox and no other (Exchange RBAC for applications), removes a tenant-wide Graph Mail.Send grant on the identity, and stores the mail settings in the EntraPolicySuite database.
whenToRun: Once after the install, and again to change the sender or the recipients.

runAs.name: Exchange Administrator (and Global Administrator for the Graph grant check)
runAs.why: creates the mailbox, the Exchange service principal, the scope and the role assignment

runAs.name: the EntraPolicySuite SQL server's Entra admin

changes.object: the shared mailbox (if it does not exist; no licence)
changes.why: the alerts are sent from it

changes.object: service principal for the engine identity, management scope <sender>-SendScope
changes.why: Exchange RBAC for applications needs both

changes.scope: the sender mailbox ONLY (the management scope)

changes.object: a tenant-wide Graph Mail.Send app role on the engine identity, if present
changes.why: it would let the engine send as any mailbox, beside the scope

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription EntraPolicySuite is installed in

parameters.name: EnvironmentName
parameters.help: the environment's name in every mail (subject and footer)

readsOnly: Exchange: the mailbox, the organization config, the service principals, scopes and role assignments
Graph: the engine identity's app roles
whatIf: Every step it would take and the settings it would store; nothing is changed.
undo: Remove the role assignment, the scope, the Exchange service principal and (if created) the mailbox; set Mail.Mode to none.
